title: Add comprehensive testing to parse command
acceptance_criteria: E2E CLI boundary tests for parse command
EARS format testing (SHALL, WHEN/THEN, WHERE, SHALL NOT, IF/THEN)
Edge case coverage (empty files, unicode, long requirements, invalid flags)
Integration testing (parse → bead generation, session creation)
End-to-end workflows (reqs.txt → parse → CUE spec → validate)
definition_of_done: Tests use actual CLI boundary (gleam run -- parse)
Tests are black-box (no internal implementation testing)
Tests cover happy path and error paths
Tests validate exit codes, JSON output, CUE output
notes: Following Farley/Fowler E2E testing principles - dogfooding exercise
